eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Application] ConnectorsJobWorkerQueueOverflowFor20Minutes
eventTemplate.description:
Connectors job worker queue >= 80 tasks for 20 minutes in namespace {dims} — queue overflow risk; check if jobs are progressing and if the cluster needs to be scaled up.

Threshold is set to > 79, equivalent to >= 80 (same workaround datadog_alerts/ used, since ABOVE is exclusive). The threshold (25 originally, since raised) is meant to track max-jobs-active + queue depth — see the source rule's TODOs before changing it.

Assumes the Connectors runtime is configured with the same Micrometer OTLP export settings as Zeebe (camunda-otlp-values.yaml only wires up zeebe/zeebeGateway, not connectors) — if Connectors is instead collector-scraped, use the underscored key `executor_queued_tasks` instead.
